Rules.InvariantScript: If(Parent.Width < 600, "Search ID, serial, device or setup", "Search by Asset ID, UA number, serial, device, manufacturer or Setup ID")

If(
    IsEmpty(colMoveBuffer),
    "No items selected yet",
    CountRows(colMoveBuffer) & If(CountRows(colMoveBuffer) = 1, " item", " items") & " ready to move"
)
"Remove this item from the move list"

"Now: " & Coalesce(ThisItem.CurrentCampus.Value, "?") & " / " & Coalesce(ThisItem.'CurrentLocation (CurrentLocation0)'.Value, "?") &
 If(
     IsEmpty(ThisItem.Setups),
     "",
     "   |   Setup: " & Concat(ThisItem.Setups, Value, ", ")
 )

Coalesce(
    LookUp(
        Equipment_Assets,
        'CurrentLocation (CurrentLocation0)'.Value = drpTargetLocation.Selected.Value
    ).CurrentCampus.Value,
    LookUp(
        Equipment_Setups,
        CurrentLocation.Value = drpTargetLocation.Selected.Value
    ).CurrentCampus.Value,
    ""
)

If(
    IsEmpty(colMoveBuffer),
        "Add at least one asset or setup to the move list first.",
    IsBlank(drpTargetLocation.Selected.Value),
        "Choose the room to move to.",
    !IsBlank(lblRoomListProblem.Text),
        "Cannot record this move: a value is missing from "
            & lblRoomListProblem.Text & ". Add it there first.",
    ""
)

If(
    IsBlank(drpTargetLocation.Selected.Value),
    "",
    !IsBlank(lblRoomListProblem.Text),
        "Cannot record this move: a value is missing from " & lblRoomListProblem.Text & ". Add it there first.",
    IsBlank(lblDerivedCampusValue.Text),
        "Campus unknown for this room, stays unchanged",
    "Campus will be " & lblDerivedCampusValue.Text
)
"Click a result to add it to the move list"

With(
    { q: Lower(Trim(txtMoveSearch.Text)) },
    Filter(
        Equipment_Setups,
        IsBlank(q)
            || !IsBlank(Find(q, Lower(Coalesce(Titel, ""))))
            || !IsBlank(Find(q, Lower(Coalesce(SetupName, ""))))
    )
)

Min(
    CountRows(
        Filter(
            Equipment_Setups,
            IsBlank(Trim(txtMoveSearch.Text))
                || !IsBlank(Find(Lower(Trim(txtMoveSearch.Text)), Lower(Coalesce(Titel, ""))))
                || !IsBlank(Find(Lower(Trim(txtMoveSearch.Text)), Lower(Coalesce(SetupName, ""))))
        )
    ) * 56,
    168
)

"Setup  |  " & Coalesce(ThisItem.CurrentCampus.Value, "?") & " / " & Coalesce(ThisItem.CurrentLocation.Value, "?") &
 "  |  " & CountRows(Filter(Equipment_Assets, ThisItem.Titel in Setups.Value)) & " asset(s)"

With(
    { q: Lower(Trim(txtMoveSearch.Text)) },
    Filter(
        Equipment_Assets,
        IsBlank(q)
            || !IsBlank(Find(q, Lower(Coalesce(Titel, ""))))
            || !IsBlank(Find(q, Lower(Coalesce(DeviceName, ""))))
            || !IsBlank(Find(q, Lower(Coalesce(Manufacturer, ""))))
            || !IsBlank(Find(q, Lower(Coalesce(SerialNumber, ""))))
            || !IsBlank(Find(q, Lower(Coalesce(UANumber, ""))))
            || !IsBlank(Find(q, Lower(Concat(Setups, Value, " "))))
    )
)
"Add this asset to the move list"

If(
    ThisItem.'Id (ID)' in colMoveBuffer.'Id (ID)',
    Icon.CheckBadge,
    Icon.AddDocument
)

If(
    ThisItem.'Id (ID)' in colMoveBuffer.'Id (ID)',
    RGBA(16, 124, 16, 1),
    RGBA(0, 120, 212, 1)
)
"No assets or setups found for """ & Trim(txtMoveSearch.Text) & """"
